info.title: ModelShared (Service)
info.description: Data model containing model dependencies of the clients of the current microservice (WebApp, ServiceTest)

get.summary: Returns the loaded EGM84-30 geoid-model information for service discovery.
get.description: This is the microservice entry endpoint. It returns the same model identity and provenance as the ModelInfo endpoint.

post.summary: Synchronously converts EGM84 mean-sea-level depths to WGS84 ellipsoidal depths.
post.description: This operation is stateless. Latitude and longitude are WGS84 radians. Input and output depths are SI metres, positive downward from their explicitly named reference surfaces. The complete request is rejected if any position is invalid.

post.summary: Synchronously converts WGS84 ellipsoidal depths to EGM84 mean-sea-level depths.
post.description: This inverse operation is stateless. Latitude and longitude are WGS84 radians. Input and output depths are SI metres, positive downward from their explicitly named reference surfaces. The complete request is rejected if any position is invalid.

get.summary: Returns the loaded EGM84-30 geoid model identity, resolution, interpolation accuracy, runtime version, and coefficient hash.
Returns cumulative usage counters retained across service restarts. This operation is intentionally not exposed as an MCP tool.

EarthVerticalDatumModelInfo.description: Identity, accuracy, and provenance of the geoid model used for conversion.

Latitude.description: WGS84 geodetic latitude in SI radians, between -π/2 and π/2.

constraints: Positions are not additive extents.

Longitude.description: WGS84 geodetic longitude in SI radians, between -π and π.

constraints: Positions are not additive extents.

MeanSeaLevelDepth.description: Depth in SI metres, positive downward from the EGM84 mean-sea-level geoid. A negative value is above that surface.

constraints: Not interchangeable with a local tidal datum, instantaneous sea surface or unspecified mean sea level.

Wgs84EllipsoidalDepth.description: Depth in SI metres, positive downward from the WGS84 reference ellipsoid.

constraints: A separation between reference surfaces, not a point depth coordinate.

DrillFloorDepthSource.description: Discriminator identifying whether the authoritative drill-floor depth belongs to the referenced rig or to the rig-job entry.

constraints: Rig means resolve depth from the referenced fixed-platform rig; job-local depth is forbidden.
RigJob means the entry owns the depth; job-local depth is required.
Undefined is a transport default, not a valid resolved ownership state.
Ownership does not specify measurement provenance or coordinate reference.

DrillFloorDepth.description: Vertical depth coordinate locating the drill floor relative to the declared vertical reference. GaussianValue.Mean is the expected value in SI metres (m), Relative to the WGS84 ellipsoid, positive downward. StandardDeviation is a non-negative standard uncertainty in SI metres (m); it has no coordinate origin. MinValue and MaxValue are provider domain-limit metadata in the mean's unit and reference, not confidence limits or instructions to truncate the Gaussian distribution.

constraints: The wrapper has no universal physical quantity; angle and depth instances share this representation.
A null standard deviation means unspecified, not zero.
Bounds do not imply a confidence interval or truncated-normal model without an explicit provider definition.

TieInPointAlongHoleDepth.description: Along-hole coordinate of a sidetrack tie-in on the parent wellbore path, using the applicable reference convention. StandardDeviation is a non-negative standard uncertainty in SI metres (m); it has no coordinate origin. MinValue and MaxValue are provider domain-limit metadata in the mean's unit and reference, not confidence limits or instructions to truncate the Gaussian distribution.

constraints: The wrapper has no universal physical quantity; angle and depth instances share this representation.
